about: Added (free) sugar per 100 g as eaten (F22). INS has no sugar column, so every packaged or prepared food is listed here; label foods take it from their label; any other food has none.

arandano-seco.from: Sweetened dried cranberries: 65 g sugars, ~10 g from the fruit

bizcocho.from: USDA 172706 pound cake: ~21 g sugars, nearly all added

chocolate.from: Drinking-chocolate tablets are about half sugar

galleta-kiwicha.from: Estimate for a sweet oat cookie, its proxy

galleta-vainilla.from: Estimate for a sweet vanilla cookie; INS reports no sugars

helado-crema.from: USDA 167575: 21.2 g sugars minus ~6 g lactose

helado-paleta.from: USDA 168813 ice pop: 18.6 g sugars, nearly all added

helado-paleta-chocolate.from: USDA 171294 coated ice cream bar: ~24 g sugars minus ~6 g lactose

kanikama.from: USDA imitation crab: 5.3 g sugars, added

ketchup.from: USDA 168556: 21.3 g sugars minus ~3 g from the tomato

leche-condensada.from: USDA 171284 sweetened condensed milk: 54.4 g sugars minus ~11.5 g lactose of the milk solids

manjar-blanco.from: Same as leche condensada, its proxy

morochas.from: Estimate until the label is read: chocolate-coated wafer, close to Oreo (39 g)

naranja-jugo.from: Squeezed juice counts as free sugar (WHO 2015); USDA 169098: 8.4 g sugars

sillao.from: Estimate: Peruvian soy sauce is lightly sweetened

yogurt-bebible.from: Flavoured drinking yogurt: ~12 g sugars minus ~4 g lactose
